title: DIO time vectors omit the canonical signed L2/RPL envelope
description: Correctness review: the DIO envelope vector/generator contains only a bare DIO payload and omits the L2 dispatch/RPL envelope, signer key, replay counter, signature, and expected receipt behavior. It cannot validate cross-implementation link-to-time verification and reinforces acceptance of noncanonical frames. Add independent literal full signed-wire positive, missing, duplicate, wrong-dispatch, wrong-signer, and replay cases.
